title: Lucifer's Declared Plan
notes: This chunk is a strong, assertive unpacking of Isaiah 14 into five sequential lunar steps, with dense consonant work, clean symbol links, and a tight close that binds the counterfeit calendar to the gospel and the feasts. The law-positive voice and checkable method hold throughout. Residual defects cluster in house-style sentence openings (multiple And/But/That starts in author prose) and light presenter staging ('Do that here', 'remember', 'Now'). No AI stock vocabulary, no mistyped scripture, and no doctrine or quote alterations required. A few modern turns remain minor and do not fight the biblical images.

proposals.old: Do that here, and the five declarations stop being repetition.
proposals.new: Done here, the five declarations stop being repetition.
proposals.rationale: House style bars presenter staging; the revision asserts the result without commanding the reader.

proposals.old: That identity governs every line of the plan.
proposals.new: This identity governs every line of the plan.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences beginning with That.

proposals.old: He is not claiming a literal seat in heaven; he is raising *his moon* — and remember whose product he is: a moon __“covered”__ in the wrong direction, clothed in darkness instead of light, the one phase that reflects nothing — over the heads of God's people.
proposals.new: He is not claiming a literal seat in heaven; he is raising *his moon* — the product of darkness: a moon __“covered”__ in the wrong direction, clothed in darkness instead of light, the one phase that reflects nothing — over the heads of God's people.
proposals.rationale: Eliminates the director 'remember' while tying the moon back to the earlier ben-shachar identity.

proposals.old: And _har_, the mountain, this book has already defined from one verse: a sym:sym-mountain[mountain] is a seat of ruling authority, a kingdom — not a geological feature (the full case study waits in Part Six).
proposals.new: _Har_, the mountain, this book has already defined from one verse: a sym:sym-mountain[mountain] is a seat of ruling authority, a kingdom — not a geological feature (the full case study waits in Part Six).
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences beginning with And.

proposals.old: That is the chair he announces he will sit in.
proposals.new: This is the chair he announces he will sit in.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences beginning with That.

proposals.old: And __“north”__ is _tsaphon_, whose root is _to hide_ — Strong's: __“properly, *hidden*, i.e. dark; used only of the north as a quarter (gloomy and unknown)”__ — the meaning the glossary's sym:sym-north[north] entry carries.
proposals.new: __“North”__ is _tsaphon_, whose root is _to hide_ — Strong's: __“properly, *hidden*, i.e. dark; used only of the north as a quarter (gloomy and unknown)”__ — the meaning the glossary's sym:sym-north[north] entry carries.
proposals.summary: Fix sentence starting with And; capitalize for sentence start.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids And-openings; capitalization matches the parallel '__“Sides”__ is' construction in the same section.

proposals.old: And __“I will be like”__ — _eddammeh_ — is written with the consonants of two verbs the dictionary keeps side by side: _damah_, __“to compare, to resemble,”__ and _damah_, __“to be dumb or *silent*; hence, to fail or perish; transitively, *to destroy*.”__
proposals.new: __“I will be like”__ — _eddammeh_ — is written with the consonants of two verbs the dictionary keeps side by side: _damah_, __“to compare, to resemble,”__ and _damah_, __“to be dumb or *silent*; hence, to fail or perish; transitively, *to destroy*.”__
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences beginning with And.

proposals.old: But _elyon_ is simply __“the highest, the uppermost”__ before it is a title; and the psalmist has already told us what the highest light is: __“the LORD God is a sym:sym-sun[sun] and shield”__ (Psalm 84:11) — the greater light that rules the day, the Father of lights (Genesis 1:16; James 1:17).
proposals.new: Yet _elyon_ is simply __“the highest, the uppermost”__ before it is a title; and the psalmist has already told us what the highest light is: __“the LORD God is a sym:sym-sun[sun] and shield”__ (Psalm 84:11) — the greater light that rules the day, the Father of lights (Genesis 1:16; James 1:17).
proposals.summary: Fix sentence starting with But; preserve contrast with Yet.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences beginning with But; Yet keeps the adversative force without violating the rule.
